named_method: AlphaFold-3-style coordinate diffusion for biomolecular complexes
structural_invariants: Token-level representation unifying protein residues, nucleic-acid bases, and ligand atoms
Single (token) representation s_i and pair representation z_ij
Trunk with iterative pair-aware updates (Pairformer-lite: triangle multiplicative + pair attention)
Generative head = denoising diffusion on Cartesian atomic positions
Forward process q(x_t | x_0) = N(sqrt(alpha_bar_t) x_0, (1 - alpha_bar_t) I)
Reverse process learned via epsilon-prediction with conditioning on (s, z, t)
Symmetry-aware permutation handling for chemically equivalent ligand atoms at evaluation

implementation_check.nucleic_acid_token_support: API present (no NA in this 2L3R sample, demonstrated via tokenizer interface)

explicit_deviations_from_AF3: No MSA features (single-sequence input) — AF3 uses MSAs via the trunk
Trunk depth/width drastically reduced for CPU; not the full Pairformer
Trained only on the single 2L3R complex as a demonstration; AF3 is trained on the entire PDB
